correctness.rationale: Proved exact weighted entry law using a three-block independence event including the departing-symbol factor. Pairwise balancing gives strict coverage maximum for all M and strict flux maximum for \(M=n,n+1\). Binary derivative polynomial has one interior zero for \(k\ge3\), yielding all maximizers, \(M=4\) certificate, and \(1/(eM)\) asymptotics. The exact surjection-count Hessian coefficient has leading positive \(L^2/r\) term at fixed n, giving eventual strict local minimum; a one-rare-type vector gives a nonasymptotic lower contribution. The standalone standard-library checker passed 234 exact checks including independent enumeration of 30 full-window cases and coefficient cross-checks. Infinite-domain steps follow from proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The parameter p is the natural sampling-design control in the same deterministic-expiration collector studied in 2026. The theorem identifies a non-obvious reversal between optimizing stationary coverage mass and optimizing frequency of arrivals into coverage: a complete threshold and optimizer for two types, strict shortest-window optimality for every alphabet, eventual local instability for every fixed alphabet, and an exponential versus inverse-window separation. These are structural boundaries, not a reparameterization or isolated finite numerical detail; the unresolved larger-alphabet exact threshold is explicitly excluded.
